items: 【Warm & Rustic Entry Table】Want to add charm and character to your space? This rustic sofa console table combines a rich vintage woodgrain finish with a bold matte black O-shaped metal frame for a warm yet modern look. Whether in your entryway or behind the sofa, it makes a stylish statement without overwhelming the space

【Extra Thick Top Surface】Crafted with a 4cm thick particleboard, the tabletop of the entry console table offers a durable surface for everyday use. The vintage wood texture adds warmth and depth to your décor, while the surface is water-resistant, scratch-resistant, and easy to clean

【O-Shaped Frame with 2 Shelves】This rustic console table features a sturdy O-shaped metal frame with 2 built-in storage shelves—perfect for books, décor, or small essentials. The open bottom space is ideal for baskets, magazines, or extra storage, giving you both style and function in one compact design

【Sized Right for Any Room】At 41.3” in length, this hallway table for entryway is perfectly sized for hallways, entryways, or behind the sofa. It provides added surface space without taking up too much room. Adjustable feet keep it balanced and stable on any floor surface

【Quick, Hassle-Free Assembly】No need to be a pro—this decorative table comes with simple, picture-based instructions, clearly labeled parts, and all tools included. You can have it fully assembled quickly
